SOLD from my personal collection is this Enicar Sherpas (not a typo!) Seapearl from 1956, matched with an Enicar signed expendable bracelet. This watch is a transitional model, placed exactly between the famous Mount Everest expedition from 1956 and the worldwide introduction of the top quality Sherpa line. A rare opportunity to own a pivotal time piece. Please send me a DM for info & price 🙏🏻

#enicar #enicarsherpa #seapearl
